name: repro-first-background-trips-correctness-fix-freeze
title: Repro-first generated background contains Authority and fails the correctness_fix scope freeze
description: story_create_from_repro writes a fixed four-section background whose Solution Tradeoffs sentence says the flow avoids pretending candidate evidence is verificationEvidence, DONE evidence, Authority proof, or production proof. scope_freeze_check in mode correctness_fix scans story.background against DEFAULT_CORRECTNESS_FIX_EXCLUDED_KEYWORDS (repair UX, Authority, Layer4, customerKeyRef), so every repro-first bug story fails the freeze with future_capability_keyword Authority in story.background. Observed on B-83aa on 2026-09-02; workaround was scope_boundary_set mode=custom. Either the generated background should avoid the reserved keywords, or the freeze scan should not treat framework-generated prose as a future-capability signal.
